title: 第11章 女神宁香依第12章 爱慕虚荣的姜凤
content_zh:
z唯一正、版、他都c是｛+盗‘《版0j
张逸风拖着行李，穿过了几条小道，刚要抵达宿舍。一道声音忽然叫住了他。
“张逸风？”
声音有些冷漠，似乎丝毫不近人情。
张逸风眉头微皱，难道又有人找麻烦，他转过头，眼神有些冷，但当他看见说话之人的时候，顿时有些尴尬。
说话的是一位女子，大约二十七八的样子，一头长发披肩散落，身穿职业服，西裤短裙和一件白色的短袖衬衣。女子面容如月，唇若点绛，带着一面金丝眼镜，手里还抱着几本书籍。
女子的身上有一股淡淡的香水味和粉笔的味道，这女子不是学生，而是一位年纪轻轻的大学老师，被誉为经开大学最美的女教师，只要她上课，几乎没有人迟到。满勤率几乎是百分之百。
为什么说几乎是百分之百呢，因为这些日子，张逸风都没有去上课，他的存在，破了女子百分之百的满勤率。
“宁老师。”
张逸风尴尬开口。
女子叫宁香依，不是语文老师，也不是英语老师，而是经济管理系的老师，张逸风的班主任，俗称辅导员。
“你还知道我是你老师，你已经一周没有来上课了，这是打算我给你评估不合格吗？”
“那个，我最近事情很多，人特别忙。”张逸风依旧很尴尬，根本不敢看宁香依。
“一个学生能有多忙？张逸风，你的事情我知道，但你不能这样自暴自弃，当年你爸能白手起家，为何你就不能？好好学习吧，经开大学的毕业证你必须拿到手，有了经开大学的毕业证，今后你才有翻身的机会。”
宁老师去到张逸风身边，拍了拍张逸风的肩膀，穿着十厘米高跟鞋的她同张逸风差不多高，宁香依虽然外表冷漠，但这一个动作，却非常温暖。
听了宁老师的话，感受到肩膀上的温暖，张逸风的身体微微颤抖，这一幕，多么熟悉，像是发生在昨天。埋藏在心里深处的画面，瞬间迸射而出。
那是大雪纷飞的一天，在漫天雪花中，一位神仙从天而降，落在天灾区，救醒了昏迷过去的他。
这是张逸风心里永远忘却不了的画面，那个人，是他心中的神明，也是他两世为人，都无法舍弃的牵挂！
当时，也是这样一双洁白温暖的手，搭在他的肩膀，告诉他，别害怕。
“我知道了。”

下意识的，张逸风说了这样一句话。原本对上课一点没有兴趣的他，居然无法说我不去。
宁香依这才笑了道：“知道就好，一个男人，可以被打倒，但不能被打败。走吧，跟我去上课，待会正好是我的课，一路吧。”
“行，但我要先放东西。”张逸风笑了，他的笑容很温暖，像是寒冰融化。宁香依都有些看呆了，好在她很快就调整了过来。
“去吧，我在你们宿舍楼下等你。”
老师等学生，在经开大学估计还是第一次发生。
宁香依刚刚站在宿舍楼下，立马引来了不少学生的围观。
“快看，那是宁老师！宁老师在我们宿舍楼下。”
“在哪里，在哪里！”

Zhang Yifeng dragged his luggage through several paths and was about to arrive at the dormitory. A voice suddenly stopped him.
"Zhang Yifeng?"
The voice was a little cold and seemed to be inhumane at all.
Zhang Yifeng frowned slightly, wondering if someone was looking for trouble again. He turned his head, his eyes a little cold, but when he saw the person who spoke, he felt a little embarrassed.
The speaker was a woman, about twenty-seven or eighty-years-old, with long hair hanging loosely around her shoulders. She was wearing business clothes, trousers, short skirt and a white short-sleeved shirt. The woman has a moon-like face, rosy lips, a pair of gold-rimmed glasses, and a few books in her hands.
There is a faint smell of perfume and chalk on the woman's body. This woman is not a student, but a young university teacher. She is known as the most beautiful female teacher at Jingkai University. As long as she attends class, almost no one is late. The attendance rate is almost 100%.
Why do I say it's almost 100%? Because Zhang Yifeng didn't go to class these days. His presence broke the woman's 100% attendance rate.
"Teacher Ning."
Zhang Yifeng spoke awkwardly.
The woman's name is Ning Xiangyi. She is not a Chinese teacher or an English teacher, but a teacher in the Department of Economics and Management, Zhang Yifeng's class teacher, commonly known as a counselor.
"You also know that I am your teacher, and you haven't come to class for a week. Do you plan on me giving you a failed assessment?"
"Well, I have a lot of things going on recently and am very busy." Zhang Yifeng was still embarrassed and didn't dare to look at Ning Xiangyi at all.
"How busy can a student be? Zhang Yifeng, I know about you, but you can't give up on yourself like this. Your father could start from scratch, why can't you? Study hard. You must get a diploma from Jingkai University. With a diploma from Jingkai University, you will have a chance to turn around in the future."
Teacher Ning went to Zhang Yifeng and patted Zhang Yifeng on the shoulder. She was about the same height as Zhang Yifeng wearing ten-centimeter high heels. Although Ning Xiangyi looked cold, this action was very warm.
After listening to Teacher Ning's words, I felt the warmth on my shoulders, and Zhang Yifeng's body trembled slightly. This scene was so familiar, as if it happened yesterday. The images buried deep in my heart burst out in an instant.
It was a snowy day. Amidst the snowflakes in the sky, a god descended from the sky and landed in the disaster area, saving him from coma.
This is a scene that Zhang Yifeng will never forget in his heart. That person is the god in his heart, and he is also the concern that he cannot let go of in his two lives!
At that time, a pair of white and warm hands put on his shoulders and told him, don't be afraid.
"I understand."
Subconsciously, Zhang Yifeng said this. He, who originally had no interest in going to class, couldn't tell me not to go.
Ning Xiangyi then smiled and said: "It's good to know that a man can be knocked down, but he cannot be defeated. Come on, go to class with me, it will be my class later, let's go together."
"Okay, but I have to put things away first." Zhang Yifeng smiled, his smile was very warm, like ice melting. Ning Xiangyi was dumbfounded, but fortunately she quickly adjusted.
"Go ahead, I'll wait for you downstairs in your dormitory."
Teachers waiting for students, this is probably the first time this has happened at Jingkai University.
Ning Xiangyi had just stood downstairs in the dormitory, and immediately attracted many students to watch.
"Look, that's Teacher Ning! Teacher Ning is downstairs in our dormitory."
"Where, where!"
